name: local-gliner25-compaction
description: Local, evidence-first GLiNER2.5 compaction for Claude Code.

pythonPath.title: Python executable
pythonPath.description: Python executable containing the gliner25_context_compaction package.

checkpoint.title: GLiNER checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Local Hugging Face checkpoint used for retention and evidence analysis.

timeoutMs.title: Worker timeout in milliseconds
timeoutMs.description: Hard deadline for the complete local Python compaction worker.

shadowMode.title: Shadow mode
shadowMode.description: Log proposed decisions without replacing session history.

fallback.title: Failure fallback
fallback.description: Use host compaction or leave history unchanged.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum character reduction required before replacing session history.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest transcript messages excluded from compaction.

minimumConfidence.title: Minimum retention confidence
minimumConfidence.description: Predictions below this confidence fail closed to full retention.

minimumEvidenceConfidence.title: Minimum evidence confidence
minimumEvidenceConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for an extracted span to affect retention.

contextCharacters.title: Context around evidence spans
contextCharacters.description: Original characters retained on each side of selected evidence.
